message: Scheduled maintenance window today 18:00–20:00 UTC. QPU-A will be unavailable. Queued jobs will resume automatically afterward.

Qubit Q7 showing elevated readout assignment error (8.2 %). Jobs using Q7 may see reduced accuracy until the next calibration cycle.
API rate limits will be enforced starting next month. Maximum 200 job submissions per user per day. Contact support to request a higher quota.

Your project allocation for QPU-A expires in 7 days. Submit a QPU time extension request to avoid interruption.
Firmware update v2.3.1 deployed to QPU-A. Improvements include reduced gate calibration drift and a 12 % decrease in median two-qubit gate error.
Job queue paused for emergency recalibration triggered by coherence threshold breach. Expected downtime: ~15 min.
New simulator backend SIM-2 is now available. It supports up to 28 qubits and mirrors the QPU-A gate set. No allocation required.
Reminder: the legacy v1 API endpoint (/v1/jobs) will be removed in 6 weeks. Please migrate to /v2/jobs. Migration guide available in the docs.
